findings.description: active() returns True when now == expires_at, but the spec requires the token to be inactive at or after expires_at.
findings.evidence: active(10, 10) evaluates to True, whereas it should be False per the spec, which defines activity strictly before expires_at.

review.summary: Candidate implements active() using a non-strict inequality, incorrectly marking tokens as active at the expiry timestamp, which violates the contract.
